summary: OpenAI is previewing a new GPT-5.6 model family (Sol, Terra, Luna), with Sol as the frontier reasoning/agentic flagship, initially available via API and Codex to select partners.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes a new flagship model setting new state-of-the-art results across coding, cybersecurity and biology evaluations.
mechanisms.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol sets a new SOTA on Terminal-Bench 2.1 , which tests command-line workflows requiring planning, iteration, and tool coordination.

mechanisms.reason: Terra is stated to match GPT-5.5 performance at half the cost, implying a smaller/more efficient model rather than a price cut on the same model.
mechanisms.quote: Terra is a balanced everyday model with GPT-5.5-competitive performance at 2x lower cost

mechanisms.reason: A new higher reasoning-effort mode is a stated model property that increases test-time compute and cache pressure per query.
mechanisms.quote: GPT-5.6 introduces a new max reasoning effort , giving Sol more time to reason deeply on difficult tasks.

mechanisms.reason: Deeper reasoning effort and subagent-based ultra mode imply more tokens and calls spent per task.
mechanisms.quote: It also introduces ultra mode , which goes beyond a single-agent setup by using subagents to accelerate complex work.

mechanisms.reason: Ultra mode explicitly describes multi-agent/subagent execution as a shipped model feature, moving work from single-agent to parallel agent execution.
mechanisms.quote: It also introduces ultra mode , which goes beyond a single-agent setup by using subagents to accelerate complex work.

practices.reason: A new flagship model with stated SOTA gains in coding and agentic/tool-use benchmarks is worth evaluating for production use on those dimensions.
practices.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol advances coding, scientific reasoning, long-horizon planning, and agentic workflows, while improving reliability and efficiency across demanding real-world tasks.

practices.reason: The document names specific benchmarks (Terminal-Bench, ExploitBench, SecureBio suite) that could inform how we measure similar capabilities, though results are the lab's own.
practices.quote: On SecureBio evaluations, GPT-5.6 reached top reported scores including 53.5% on the Virology Capabilities Test, 60.0% on Molecular Biology, 68.4% on Human Pathogen Capabilities, and 68.3% on World-Class Bio, about 9 percentage points above GPT-5.5

practices.reason: Ultra mode's subagent approach is a directionally interesting orchestration pattern but is described only at a high level, not as an implementable technique.
practices.quote: It also introduces ultra mode , which goes beyond a single-agent setup by using subagents to accelerate complex work.

practices.reason: Limited preview access via API and Codex to select partners means most teams have no integration work yet, but availability will need tracking as it broadens.
practices.quote: During the preview, GPT‑5.6 models will initially be available through the API and Codex to a select group of trusted partners and organizations.

notable_reason: This is the first announcement of a new GPT-5.6 flagship model family with claimed SOTA results across coding, cybersecurity and biology evaluations.
